children: A selloff in tech stocks makes for a challenging backdrop to one of the most anticipated initial public offerings in history.

According to users of Kalshi's prediction market, Anthropic's chances of pulling off its listing this year have slumped to below 60%, down from nearly 90% on the eve of the midterms. Still, bettors remain confident that the IPO will happen in the next few months.

Even before the poll, the tech selloff was weighing on the valuation investors were eyeing for the company behind the Claude chatbot. They were pushing for a figure of around $1.5 trillion to $1.6 trillion, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday, compared with figures closer to $2 trillion earlier.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
